findings: 1. Sanitization collision resolved: Clinical ICD-10 diagnoses and tooth formulas are preserved in audit logging via sanitizeAuditPayload while passwords, PAN/CVV card data, and tokens are redacted.
2. Fastify route immutability hardened: DELETE, PUT, PATCH on /api/audit/events, /api/audit/events/:id, and /api/audit/events/batch reject mutations with 403 AuditLogImmutable.
3. Offline queue resilience: StaffActionAuditService buffers actions locally and drains to POST /api/audit/events/batch on network restore.
4. Doctor autonomy respected: All audit logging is non-blocking, asynchronous, and never disrupts chairside workflows or displays intrusive dialogs.
5. CBCT / DICOM / Tomography / Radiology invariant: Strictly 0 lines modified in CBCT / DICOM modules per explicit user command.
